_comment: Contractor source rules (HR-driven identity guide, Gate 2; Book 03, Appendix A, Contractor leavers). The earliest end is the first of: contract end, the completion date when earlier, suitability withdrawn, the card terminated, revoked or expired, the sponsor's separation plus the grace period, and a missed sponsor recertification. The review settings go on the contractor access package's assignment policy: bi-annual, the sponsor (the manager) reviews, a named fallback, and remove access when no one responds. Grace and recertification periods are design guidance; the agency sets them.
